# relaybox r2
setting|signature|sha256=<hex>|2026-10-01
setting|signature|t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>|2026-10-15
setting|timeout|30s|2026-09-01
setting|payload|json|2026-09-01
setting|env|production|2026-09-01
setting|migrate_on_startup|true|2026-09-01
rule||Send X-Relaybox-Signature: sha256=<hex>.|2026-10-01
rule||Keep the timeout at 30s because cold starts need the headroom.|2026-09-01
rule||Keep the payload as json because the receiver expects one object.|2026-09-01
rule||Read configuration from the environment only because the host injects it.|2026-09-01
rule||Migrate on startup because the process owns the schema.|2026-09-01
